gloss: like; just as; in the same way as

definitions.gloss: like; as; in the manner of
definitions.explanation: Attaches to a noun to compare an action or state to it. The adverbial counterpart of のような, which modifies nouns instead of verbs and adjectives.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧のように⟦{飛|と}びたい→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: I want to fly like a bird.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧のように⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。

⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おっしゃった→おっしゃる：01299_ossharu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: As the teacher said, I came to see that preparation matters more than anything.

notes:
USAGE:
After a noun, use のように (⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧のように⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧). After a verb or i-adjective, drop ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ and use よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ directly (⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). With na-adjectives the linker is な (⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧なよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧のように: like a dream
- ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧のように: almost every day
- ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧のように: as before
- ⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧のように: as follows (written)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- のような: like — the same comparison used to modify a noun (⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧のような⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧)
- ⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: like — casual spoken equivalent, attaches directly to the noun
- ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ごとく: like, as — literary and archaic-sounding
